title: The Spiritual Academy Competition begins
summary: The teams are teleported onto the Relic Continent, and name cards introduce the rival captains: Wen Qingxuan of the Phoenix Spiritual Academy with Pin'er and Le'er, Liu Qingyun of the Blue Sky Academy, and Wu Yingying and Wu Ling of the Martial Spiritual Academy. North Heaven starts with only 10 points, so Mu Chen sends Mu Fengyang out to shout about a team with 500 points. Once the greedy teams gather, Luo Li and Zhao Qingshan seal the valley and take everyone's points. The team then tracks Liu Ying, whose Desolate Spiritual Academy team is under siege by four teams including Qiu Beihai and Shen Jun of Blue Sky. Mu Chen beats both Human Body Disaster cultivators with his body alone, even though Qiu Beihai sneers that he is only at late Heavenly Completion. Liu Ying hands over a jade slip about ruins holding Spiritual Fruits that help people pass the Human Body Disaster, and agrees to cooperate under Mu Chen's 'pig-farming' threat. Elsewhere Xiao Yan tells Yao Chen that Xun'er's bloodline reacted to the Ancient Pagoda Clan, and that Futu Xuan thinks the two share an origin.
events: Teams arrive on the Relic Continent; the Phoenix, Holy, Blue Sky and Martial captains are introduced by name cards
North Heaven draws 10 points; Mu Fengyang lures teams with a fake 500-point claim and the team takes all their points
The leaderboard: 1. Phoenix (Wen Qingxuan), 2. Holy (Ji Xuan), 3. Martial (Wu Ling)
The team tracks Liu Ying, who is besieged by four teams
Mu Chen defeats Qiu Beihai and Shen Jun; Luo Li, Mu Fengyang and Zhao Qingshan beat the rest
Liu Ying gives up the jade slip about the relic ruins and agrees to cooperate
Xiao Yan and Yao Chen discuss Xun'er's bloodline reacting to the Ancient Pagoda Clan
cultivation: Name cards: Wen Qingxuan at the peak of the Spiritual Energy Disaster; Pin'er, Le'er and Liu Qingyun at the Spiritual Energy Disaster; Wu Ling at the middle phase of it; Wu Yingying at the peak of the Human Body Disaster; Qiu Beihai and Shen Jun at the Human Body Disaster. Mu Chen is still at late Heavenly Completion. Liu Ying passed the Human Body Disaster half a year ago.
